question: Who received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1962 for his ‘pioneering theory for condensed matter, especially liquid helium’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lev Davidovich Landau.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lev Davidovich Landau received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1962 for his ‘pioneering theory for condensed matter, especially liquid helium.**

 
 
• He was a** Soviet physicist of Jewish.**
 
• He made fundamental contributions to many areas of **theoretical physics. **
 
• His accomplishments include the independent co-discovery of the density matrix method in **quantum mechanics.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wolfgang Pauli:**

 
 
• He was a Swiss and American theoretical physicist.
 
• He won the Nobel prize in Physics in **1945 for his "decisive contribution through his discovery of a new law of Nature, the exclusion principle or Pauli principle".**
 
• The discovery involved spin theory, which is the basis of a theory of the structure of matter.
 
• Pauli made major contributions to quantum mechanics, quantum field theory, and solid-state physics.
 
 
 
• **Ernest Orlando Lawrence:**
 
 
• He was an **American nuclear scientist who received The Noble Prize in 1939 for his invention of the cyclotron.**
 
• **Cyclotron is a particle accelerator technology that can be used in particle therapy to treat cancer.**
 
 
 
• **John Bardeen:**
 
 
• He is the only person to be awarded the** Nobel Prize in Physics twice.**
 
• **John Bardeen received the Nobel prize for physics in 1956 for amplifying electric signals proved decisive for telephony and radio.**
 
• He received the Nobel prize for physics in 1972 for formulating a theory based on quantum mechanics.
